nodes.name: W22: inContact format changed (alert)
nodes.notes: kind=incontact_format_change, level=alert: an FNB alert could not be read. Message ids only. Statement import (W18) still catches the money.

parameters.content:
## W17 inContact parser
Graph poll of howzit@ every 2 min (target: 100% of payments matched within 15 min).
Filter: FNB sender domain + credit/payment subject; DMARC/DKIM/SPF fail -> rejected.
Recognised credit -> bank_credits (unique graph_message_id) -> W16.
Unreadable FNB alert -> alert; new wording -> warning (fingerprints in static data).
ASSUMPTION: FNB wording and sender; validate on 20 real alerts at GATE-INCONTACT.
Invite NDRs (Undeliverable: Your call with ...) -> W05 invite_bounced (recipient only; I-49b).
